title: 第158章 我喜欢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

宋禾和顾新礼等人进入内室，等兴隆布庄的掌柜。

“小禾，这是什么情况？咱们都这么久没来这边了，那店伙计竟然还能认出你来？”顾新礼奇怪的说。

宋禾道：“可是咱们上次来卖布的时候，对方

顾新礼皱眉，压低声音，“我就怕……”

宋禾和顾新礼对视，她明白顾新礼的意思，顾新礼是怕棉贡缎的事情暴露。

宋禾轻笑，“没事，二哥放心，反正就是一个布。”

要是暴露，她就直接把方法卖了，转头去做别的生意，条条大路通罗马，人总不能稍微一遇时就被绊住再也不往前走啊。

宋禾的淡定感染了顾新礼，顾新礼慢慢冷静下来。

郑碾一头雾水，“二哥，你们说什么呢？”

顾新礼随口道：“在说一会儿怎么卖布。”

话音刚落，内室的门帘就被人掀开。

“顾老板，宋老板。”一个身穿长袍的中年男人走进来。

几人从位置上站起身。

“坐坐坐。”杨掌柜笑着道，然后对身边的店伙计说，“快去烧些热水，泡上好茶招待几位贵客，一定得是好茶。”

“唉。”

杨掌柜笑着坐下，看向顾新礼和宋禾。

“两位可是让我好等啊，我还以为二人再也不来府城卖布了呢。”

宋禾轻笑，“今天我一进来，就被您店里的伙计认出来了，可是吓了我一大跳，还以为我上次卖给布庄的货出了什么问题呢。”

“宋老板上次的货，是这个！”杨掌柜伸出一根大拇指，“不管是布匹质量，还是颜色都非常好。要是您再不来，我这边说不定就跑到安原县找您买去了。”

听了杨掌柜这句话，顾新礼压下心中激动，他知道，对方这句话一出，今天的生意就已经成一半了。

杨掌柜道：“不知道这次顾老板和宋老板带了多少货来。就上次那样的布，我兴隆布庄可是缺的很啊。”

宋禾拿出自己带来的样布，又拿出自己事先准备好的布料花色展示板递给杨掌柜。

Song He, Gu Xinli and others entered the inner room and waited for the shopkeeper of Xinglong Buzhuang.

"Xiaohe, what's going on? We haven't been here for so long, and the shop assistant still recognizes you?" Gu Xinli said strangely.

Song He said: "But the last time we came to sell cloth, the other party

Gu Xinli frowned and lowered his voice, "I'm just afraid..."

Song He and Gu Xinli looked at each other. She understood what Gu Xinli meant. Gu Xinli was afraid that the matter of Mian Gongsatin would be exposed.

Song He chuckled lightly, "It's okay, second brother, don't worry, it's just a piece of cloth anyway."

If exposed, she would simply sell the method and turn around to other businesses. All roads lead to Rome, and people can't be stumbling upon it at the first encounter and never move forward.

Song He's calmness infected Gu Xinli, and Gu Xinli slowly calmed down.

Zheng Nian was confused, "Second brother, what are you talking about?"

Gu Xinli said casually: "I'm talking about how to sell cloth later."

As soon as he finished speaking, the door curtain of the inner room was opened.

"Boss Gu, Boss Song."A middle-aged man in a robe walked in.

Several people stood up from their positions.

“Sit, sit, sit.Shopkeeper Yang said with a smile, and then said to the shop assistant beside him, "Go and boil some hot water and make good tea to entertain a few distinguished guests. It must be good tea.""

"well."

Shopkeeper Yang sat down with a smile and looked at Gu Xinli and Song He.

"You two kept me waiting. I thought they would never come to Fucheng to sell cloth again."

Song He chuckled, "As soon as I came in today, I was recognized by the clerk in your store, but I was shocked. I thought there was something wrong with the goods I sold to Cloth Store last time."

“Boss Song’s last shipment was this!Shopkeeper Yang gave a thumbs up, "Both the quality of the cloth and the color are very good."If you don't come again, I might go to Anyuan County to buy it from you."

After hearing what Shopkeeper Yang said, Gu Xinli suppressed his excitement. He knew that as soon as the other party said these words, today's business would be half done.

Shopkeeper Yang said: “I don’t know how much goods Boss Gu and Boss Song brought this time.Just like last time, our Xinglong Cloth Village is in short supply."

Song He took out the sample fabric he brought, and then took out the fabric pattern display board he had prepared in advance and handed it to Shopkeeper Yang.
